subject: Physics
source_note: TIE (2023), Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics
competences: (a) Explain the concept of Physics (Meaning, branches and connection with other disciplines)
(b) Discuss the contribution of Physics to the development of modern society
(c) Explain concepts of physical quantities (fundamental and derived quantities) and their, SI units
(d) Describe concepts of linear motion (speed, velocity, acceleration, distance, and displacement)
(e) Explain the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power, energy
(f) Deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating
(g) Describe the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept of Physics (Meaning, branches and connection with other disciplines)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concept of Physics is clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Discuss the contribution of Physics to the development of modern society
objectives.resources: Balls, conical pendulum, banked road, whirling water in bucket, telescope, solid object, Earth globe, calipers or rulers, jug, F1-10 hydraulics bench and stopwatch
objectives.assessment_criteria: Contributions of Physics to the development of modern society are clearly discussed

objectives.text: (c) Explain concepts of physical quantities (fundamental and derived quantities) and their, SI units
objectives.resources: Tape measure, vernier caliper, stopwatch, protractor, beam balance, magnetic compass and force gauge
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of physical quantities are clearly explained

objectives.text: (d) Describe concepts of linear motion (speed, velocity, acceleration, distance, and displacement)
objectives.teaching_methods: Circle the sage, Questions and answers, ICT based learning
objectives.resources: String, bob, fixed point, smooth table surface, single pulley, springs, masses and online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of linear motion are clearly described

objectives.text: (e) Explain the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power, energy
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, ICT based learning, Questions and answers
objectives.resources: Water tank, basin, different liquids, different solid materials, worksheet, online resources, spring balance and video
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power and energy are explained clearly

objectives.text: (f) Deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating
objectives.resources: Water tank, sinking objects, worksheets, stone, dry wood, picture of floating and sinking objects and online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The relationship between density, sinking and floating is correctly deduced

objectives.text: (g) Describe the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy
objectives.teaching_methods: Think-ink pair share, Group discussion, Experimentation
objectives.resources: Metal rod, wooeden rod, spring and masses, liquid (water), different shapes and sizes conatiner, glass jar with cork and rubber band
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, power and energy are explained clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic terminologies, measurements and symbols in Physics
competences: (a) Describe various instruments used for measurement in Physics
(b) Relate measuring instruments to physical quantities

objectives.text: (a) Describe various instruments used for measurement in Physics
objectives.teaching_methods: Circle-the-sage, Project work, Virtual lab experiment
objectives.resources: Online resources, flow-tube, thermometers, stopwatch, retort stand, vernier calliper and steel balls of varying diameters
objectives.assessment_criteria: Measuring instruments used in Physics measurements are correctly described

objectives.text: (b) Relate measuring instruments to physical quantities
objectives.assessment_criteria: Precision and accuracy of measurements are clearly related

sub_topics.title: Use mathematics to explain physical principles and phenomena
competences: (a) Use mathematical knowledge to describe relationship between various physical quantities (force, velocity, acceleration, density, pressure)

objectives.text: (a) Use mathematical knowledge to describe relationship between various physical quantities (force, velocity, acceleration, density, pressure)
objectives.resources: Online resources and Physics reference books
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mathematical knowledge is used to describe the relationship between various physical quantities

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic experimental skills in Physics
competences: (a) Conduct experiments related to linear motion, density, force, pressure, work, energy, power and mechanical properties of matter

objectives.text: (a) Conduct experiments related to linear motion, density, force, pressure, work, energy, power and mechanical properties of matter
objectives.resources: Online resources, Small masses, meter rule, stop watch, trolley model calipers, wooden and metal rods, balances, string and pulley
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experiments are properly conducted following the scientific method

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of data analysis, presentation and report writing in Physics
competences: (a) Explain the methods of analysing experimental data in physics (statistical analysis)
(b) Use analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics
(c) Use graphical method to present experimental results in physics

objectives.text: (a) Explain the methods of analysing experimental data in physics (statistical analysis)
objectives.resources: Data and Online resources, Physics reference books
objectives.assessment_criteria: The methods of analysing experimental data are explained correctly

objectives.text: (b) Use analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics
objectives.resources: Data and Online resources, Physics reference books
objectives.assessment_criteria: Analytical methods to manipulate experimental data in physics are correctly performed

objectives.text: (c) Use graphical method to present experimental results in physics
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Use of ICT facility
objectives.resources: Data and online resources, Physics reference books and different graph papers
objectives.assessment_criteria: The graphical method to present experimental results in physics is clearly used

topics.title: Evaluate and use information in Physics

sub_topics.title: Collect, describe and relate physical data
competences: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical quantities (density, force, pressure)
(b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter

objectives.text: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical quantities (density, force, pressure)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The data used to explain various physical parameters are collected and analysed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
objectives.assessment_criteria: The physical data to explain experimental observations related to given concepts are appropriately collected and analysed

sub_topics.title: Carry out a project in Physics
competences: (a) Develop prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles and laws gained from the field of linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter

objectives.text: (a) Develop prototype devices based on the concepts, theories, principles and laws gained from the field of linear motion, force, density, pressure and mechanical properties of matter
objectives.assessment_criteria: Prototypes are developed based on Physics
